info.title: v2.livestream.create_session
info.description: Create a new live stream, include basic information, like cover, title, description, type (test live or normal live). (For TW, ID, TH, PH, MY, SG, VN)

post.description: Create a new live stream, include basic information, like cover, title, description, type (test live or normal live). (For TW, ID, TH, PH, MY, SG, VN)

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: cover_image_url
parameters.description: The cover image URL of livestream session. Please call the v2.livestream.upload_image to upload the cover image file and get the cover_image_url.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description of livestream session, cannot exceed 200 characters.

parameters.name: is_test
parameters.description: Indicate whether the livestream session is for testing purpose only.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by(depends on different APIs) partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, user_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The title of livestream session, cannot exceed 200 characters.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a user.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/livestream/create_session?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&user_id=user_id',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "cover_image_url": "https://cf.shopee.sg/file/id-11134104-7r98o-m9pq7jw2cdhx5e",
    "description": "test",
    "is_test": false,
    "title": "test livestream"
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

import requests
import json

url = "https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/livestream/create_session?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&user_id=user_id"

payload=json.dumps({
  "cover_image_url": "https://cf.shopee.sg/file/id-11134104-7r98o-m9pq7jw2cdhx5e",
  "description": "test",
  "is_test": False,
  "title": "test livestream"
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.RPCRequest("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)
